finding: The 2806's boot reads 243 of the 93C66's 256 words and writes one. Order: word 0x00 read, and because it is blank the firmware write-enables, writes 0x0000 and write-disables; then words 0x5e..0x66 (94..102), the datapump block already documented; then a linear sweep 0x00..0xf2. Words 0xf3..0xff are never touched.
not_reproduced: AT&W answers OK and programs nothing. idsdl-extended-registers.md records AT&W programming words 0x00-0x22, measured on the 302 image with a persistent --nvram file; that was retried here on IDSDL302.ROM through the same CLI route, and on the 2806 capture with ATE0&W, ATS0=3&W and AT&F&W, and every run wrote only the boot-time word 0.
